deathStreakFit.formula: bounty = max(100, base * (1 - deaths * (perDeath + perDeficit * max(0, relPivot - rel)))), base = killLevel formula (+ firstBloodExtra), deaths = victim deaths since last kill, rel = victim totalGold / mean totalGold of all 10 at the frame before the kill
deathStreakFit.tableNote: deathStreak = [victim deaths since last kill (7 = 7+), 300 * mean(bounty / base)]: the gold for a level 1-6 victim; scale by base / 300 for higher levels

shutdown.formula: shutdown = min(700, max(0, perKill * K + perAssist * A + perGoldLead * max(0, G))) * clamp((T - teamFrom) / (teamFull - teamFrom), 0, 1); K = victim kills since last death, A = victim assists since last death, G = victim totalGold - mean totalGold of all 10, T = victim team totalGold - enemy team totalGold, all at the frame before the kill. shutdownBounty is paid to the killer on top of bounty.
shutdown.tableNote: byStreak [victim kills since last death (8 = 8+), mean shutdownBounty, kills]; byLead (G) and byTeamLead (T) [bucketStart, mean shutdownBounty, kills], first bucket also holds everything below, last everything above

goldCheck.note: per-minute totalGold residuals after a CS/jungle CS/level-up/role baseline fitted on quiet minutes (no kill, no building, plate or epic monster in the minute; supports left out)

bounty.assist: Each assister gets about 49% / 29% / 25% / 22% of the kill's bounty when 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 champions assist (team pool 49% / 58% / 76% / 90% of bounty, so the pool grows with more assisters instead of a flat 50% split); shutdownBounty is not shared with assisters (fitted share about 0). Killer receives bounty + shutdownBounty.

objective.note: bounty on BUILDING_KILL / ELITE_MONSTER_KILL is the team total paid to the taking team, only while an objective bounty is active for it: OBJECTIVE_BOUNTY_PRESTART (15 s warning) fires only after 14:00 and only for the team behind in gold. deficit = enemy team totalGold - taking team totalGold at the event time (interpolated between frames). activeFrom = earliest actualStartTime seen (s).
objective.byDeficitNote: [deficitBucketStart, objectives taken after activeFrom, share with bounty > 0, mean bounty when paid]
